keyLimits.en: Node-locked to 2 machines (10 activations/year), 12 months of updates included, STEP/OBJ/STL/Parasolid export, FBX import
Node-locked to 4 machines, professional surfacing tools, IGES/ACIS/Rhino/DXF/DWG support, beta program access

cautions.en: Licenses are perpetual but only include 12 months of version updates; continuing to get new versions afterward likely requires renewing maintenance (not fully detailed on the page).

capabilities.en: Direct, non-history-based 3D modeling with NURBS surfacing (Parasolid and xNURBS kernels)
Complex Boolean operations with watertight results
Intelligent fillets, construction planes, bridge curves and live engineering-grade dimensions

limitations.en: Starter/trial tier restricted to non-commercial use and limited export formats (STEP, low-res OBJ/STL)
Licenses are node-locked to a limited number of machines (2 for Indie, 4 for Studio)

unknowns: Whether renewing updates after 12 months requires an additional fee is not stated on the page reviewed
conflicts: Seed data listed an Indie/Studio one-time price of $149; the live pricing page shows Indie at $175 and Studio at $299.
